# EXP-004 H1 agent report: informative paths under a fixed native readout

**AI reporting statement.** This report was generated by OpenAI Codex from the
machine-generated artifacts identified below. It consolidates the canonical
qualification, task-head qualification, structured pilot and frozen
source-wise discovery stages. Numerical observations are separated from
protocol interpretation. Neither the official ARC-Easy validation split nor
the official test split was accessed.

## H1 and current evidential status

H1 asks whether a noncanonical Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct execution path can retain
near-canonical ARC-Easy information for a small path-specific linear task head
while becoming substantially less readable to the frozen native A--E language
model readout.

For a path `P`, define:

- `A_task(P)`: accuracy of a path-specific bias-free `3072 x 5` linear head;
- `A_native(P)`: accuracy of the frozen final RMSNorm and A--E LM-head rows;
- `P` is good when `A_task(canonical) - A_task(P) <= 0.05`;
- a good path is a readability-collapse witness when its native accuracy loses
  at least 0.15 absolutely, or at least 50% of the canonical-to-chance interval.

The current result is a **positive train-discovery existence signal**, not a
final acceptance of H1. The source-wise run found an adaptive witness and the
pre-declared `repeat_L28` control independently provides a strong witness. But
all adaptive good paths came from S2, so the intended cross-source condition
was not met. Validation selection/freeze and the one-time test stage remain
unrun.

## Canonical and task-head qualification

The initial canonical qualification verified that the modular execution of
`[1,2,...,28]` was exactly equal to the native model forward within the same
process: feature and A--E-logit max/mean absolute differences were all `0.0`.

The first provisional `L2=1e-6` head overfit `D_fit` and reached only 0.8822
on `D_discover`. A second engineering-only D_fit cross-validation selected
`L2=0.3`:

|---|---:|---|
| selected L2 | 0.3 | `EXP-20260827-004-h1-head-qualification-v2/head_qualification.json` |

| full-D_fit refit `D_discover` accuracy | 0.9182 | same file |
| refit `D_discover` cross-entropy | 0.2610 | same file |

This selected head specification, rather than the provisional head, was
frozen for the structured pilot and source-wise discovery.

The zero-good result for S1/S3/S4/S5 does not establish that those source
families cannot produce good paths. Their sampled paths remained shallow
(median 7--8, maximum 12--13), whereas all observed good paths were S2 paths
of length 24--28. The fragmented early-readability diagnostic subsequently
found that isolated blocks and canonical prefixes through L11 are at chance
for fitted linear readouts, while canonical-prefix signal emerges around
L12--L13. That later diagnostic is compatible with insufficient search depth
in these four sources; it does not retroactively change H1 denominators.

## Cache intervention and recovery disclosure

After candidate 230, a measured GPU/SSD/HDD hierarchy replaced the initial
disk-cache implementation without changing paths, RNG, representations,
logits, heads or acceptance criteria.

| Cache/throughput datum | Value | Artifact path relative to `ARTIFACTS_ROOT` |
|---|---:|---|
| GPU L1 final nodes / bytes | 4 / 7.706 GB | `EXP-20260828-004-h1-sourcewise-rerun/discovery_summary.json` |
| SSD L2 nodes / bytes | 112 / 215.77 GB | same file |
| HDD L3 nodes / bytes | 74 / 142.56 GB | same file |
| GPU cache hits / SSD loads | 82 / 477 | same file |
| pre-intervention mean model time | 23.43 s/candidate | `events.jsonl`, summarized in the stage report |
| post-intervention mean model time | 11.62 s/candidate | same provenance |
| measured reduction | 50.4% | derived from those journaled means |

The active policy and its hash are in
`EXP-20260828-004-h1-sourcewise-rerun/operational_cache_policy.json`; the
terminal cache index is `prefix_cache_index.sqlite3` and stored SSD pages are
under `prefix_cache_ssd/`.

The first process using the new hierarchy completed candidates 231--233 and
then raised an `AttributeError` before candidate 234's forward because the old
index lacked the new LRU-touch method. The retry reproduced the failure
without committing candidate 234. The interface was added, the already
committed state was resumed, and the run continued through candidate 1749.
The full execution journal is
`EXP-20260828-004-h1-sourcewise-rerun/events.jsonl`; the supervisor journal is
`EXP-20260828-004-h1-sourcewise-rerun-supervisor-events.jsonl`, both relative
to `ARTIFACTS_ROOT`. The terminal manifest has no stale top-level error.

## Protocol-facing conclusion

On `D_discover`:

1. The adaptive existence criterion `n_gap >= 1` has a positive signal.
2. The independently pre-declared `repeat_L28` control is a stronger separate
   existence witness and is correctly excluded from adaptive prevalence.
3. The adaptive descriptive `p_gap=1/6=16.7%` exceeds the protocol reference
   `p0=10%`, but the denominator is only six and the adaptive sample is not IID.
4. The cross-source criterion is not met: every adaptive good path and the
   adaptive witness came from S2.
5. Therefore H1 is **not finally accepted**. Validation selection/freeze and
   the one-time official-test confirmation remain outstanding.
